item.title: LiveKit Agents AI agent update: You can recover caller answers that GPT-Live transcribes but never delegates. After a quiet grace period, a detector checks missed
item.description: You can recover caller answers that GPT-Live transcribes but never delegates. After a quiet grace period, a detector checks missed turns and starts backend delegation when needed, with a note for answers spoken over the agent. GPTLiveModel(delegation_recovery=True) - **xAI**: `xai/stt-2` through Inference, with word alignment for adaptive interruption. - **Google**: Gemini 4 Carbon, Gemini 4 Hydro
